lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Design Thinking Principles
lessons.description: In this lesson, students will be introduced to the core principles of design thinking, including empathy, prototyping, and iterative testing. They will also learn about the innovation process and how to identify areas of opportunity for innovation.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Human-Centered Design and Empathy Building
lessons.description: Students will learn about human-centered design and the importance of empathy in innovation. They will practice empathy-building techniques through role-playing and small group discussions.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Validation Techniques and Case Studies
lessons.description: This lesson focuses on validating opportunities and solutions through validation techniques such as the Forge 231 Ovation Rubric. Students will analyze case studies to understand how validation can mitigate risk and lead to successful innovation.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Applied Design Thinking Tools and Minimum Usable Prototype
lessons.description: Students will learn about the concept of Minimum Usable Prototype (MUP) and how to create one. They will also learn how to design and craft a value proposition and test it effectively.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: System Thinking and Concept Generation
lessons.description: In this lesson, students will delve into system thinking, understanding complex systems, and the process of generating and evaluating solution concepts. They will also explore how to build a compelling value proposition and design a concept generation process.
